verdicts.note: The report describes push notifications for schedule edits being suppressed during daytime hours because quiet hours are being evaluated against headquarters time instead of the local branch time zone.
The report explicitly denies experiencing the paid break overtime calculation bug and complains about print formatting, which is not among the listed problems.
The report precisely matches the issue where an accepted shift swap stays awaiting approval because it evaluates an outdated role snapshot from when the offer was created.
The report explicitly states push notifications work fine after reinstalling and complains about font size, which does not match any listed problem.
The report explicitly denies experiencing the demoted manager access issue and reports an unlisted problem regarding timesheet printing layout.
The report accurately describes staffing coverage treating shadow trainees as fully qualified workers and showing green coverage when qualified staff are removed.
The report precisely describes an unclosed first time entry upon a cross-site transfer causing overlapping hours to inflate overtime calculations.
The report accurately describes duplicate employee profiles being created upon retrying pending invitations, matching the expected problem despite mentioning a version number.
The report precisely describes delegated schedule edits showing only the represented manager in the audit log rather than the actual editor, matching the listed problem.
The report directly describes a demoted manager continuing to approve timesheets using an existing open session, matching the known problem.
The report explicitly confirms that duplicate employee profiles are not occurring and instead requests a feature to customize the welcome email text, matching none of the listed problems.
The report accurately describes an overnight shift disappearing from the following day's daily view while still appearing on the weekly overview and on its start date.
The report asks about setting an expiration date for recurring availability patterns, which does not match any of the listed product problems.
The report explicitly states the staffing coverage issue is not occurring and raises an unlisted printing issue regarding clipped footers.
The report explicitly identifies that a newly cloned branch inherited headquarters coordinates rather than its own map pin, matching the expected problem.
The report precisely describes automatic swap approval being turned off in the background after location edits while the open tab still displays it as enabled.
The report accurately describes timesheet edits failing to save when emoji are included in manager notes and succeeding once they are removed.
The report explicitly confirms that the failure was caused by revoked external payroll authorization while settings still showed 'Connected', matching the expected problem description.
The report accurately describes weekly overtime being inflated by paid break minutes that are already part of the shift total.
The report accurately describes shift swaps remaining stuck awaiting approval because role qualifications were obtained after the swap was created, matching the expected problem.
